note: Lines marked (2) are sung twice before continuing, per the ×٢ marks in the source.

verses.ar:
يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَاءِ بِالَّذِي صَنَّاكْ (2)
لَا تُخَيِّبْنَا يَا سَيِّدِي نَحْنُ جِيرَانَكْ
يَا سَيِّدِي نَحْنُ جِيرَانَكْ
اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّي
عَوْنِي وَحَسْبِي مَا لِي سِوَاهُ
verses.tr:
Yā Abā-z-Zahrāʾi bi-lladhī ṣannāk (2)
Lā tukhayyibnā yā sayyidī naḥnu jīrānak
Yā sayyidī naḥnu jīrānak
Allāhu Allāhu Allāhu Rabbī
ʿAwnī wa ḥasbī mā lī siwāh
verses.en: O father of Zahra, by the One who fashioned you — do not turn us away, O my master, we are your neighbours, O my master, we are your neighbours. Allah, Allah, Allah is my Lord; He is my help and my sufficiency, I have none besides Him.

verses.ar:
رُوحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ مَا بَيْنَ الْخُلَّانْ (2)
جَنَّةُ الرِّضْوَانْ يَا سَيِّدِي فِي حَضْرَتِنَا
يَا سَيِّدِي فِي حَضْرَتِنَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Rūḥun wa rayḥānun mā bayna-l-khullān (2)
Jannatu-r-riḍwān yā sayyidī fī ḥaḍratinā
Yā sayyidī fī ḥaḍratinā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: Rest and fragrance among close companions — the Garden of Good Pleasure, O my master, is in our presence, O my master, in our presence.

verses.ar:
حَضْرَةُ الْقُدُّوسْ مُحْيَا النُّفُوسْ (2)
جَنَّةُ الْفِرْدَوْسْ يَا سَيِّدِي تَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْنَا
يَا سَيِّدِي تَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْنَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Ḥaḍratu-l-quddūs muḥyā-n-nufūs (2)
Jannatu-l-firdaws yā sayyidī taḥtāju ilaynā
Yā sayyidī taḥtāju ilaynā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: The Holy Presence, the reviver of souls — the Garden of Paradise, O my master, longs for us, O my master, longs for us.

verses.ar:
مِنْ خَمْرِ الْعِرْفَانِ سُقِّينَا قِدْحًا (2)
مِنْ يَدِ الْوِلْدَانِ يَا سَيِّدِي مُخَلَّدِينَا
يَا سَيِّدِي مُخَلَّدِينَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Min khamri-l-ʿirfāni suqqīnā qidḥan (2)
Min yadi-l-wildāni yā sayyidī mukhalladīnā
Yā sayyidī mukhalladīnā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: From the wine of gnosis we have been given to drink, poured by the hands of the ever-living youths, O my master, made everlasting.

verses.ar:
حَالُ الْعَارِفِينَ مُتَقَابِلِينْ (2)
عَلَى سُرُرٍ يَا سَيِّدِي مُسْتَبْشِرِينَا
يَا سَيِّدِي مُسْتَبْشِرِينَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Ḥālu-l-ʿārifīna mutaqābilīn (2)
ʿAlā sururin yā sayyidī mustabshirīnā
Yā sayyidī mustabshirīnā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: Such is the state of the gnostics, facing one another upon couches, O my master, filled with glad tidings, O my master, with glad tidings.

verses.ar:
أَبْنَاءُ الْحَضْرَةِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى (2)
مِنْ قَبْلِ الْأُخْرَى يَا سَيِّدِي مُعَزَّزِينَا
يَا سَيِّدِي مُعَزَّزِينَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
Abnāʾu-l-ḥaḍrati lahumu-l-bushrā (2)
Min qabli-l-ukhrā yā sayyidī muʿazzazīnā
Yā sayyidī muʿazzazīnā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: The people of that Presence have good news before any other, O my master, held in honour, O my master, in honour.

verses.ar:
عِبَادُ الرَّحْمٰنِ فِي كُلِّ زَمَانْ (2)
لَهُمُ الْأَمَانْ يَا سَيِّدِي مُطْمَئِنِّينَا
يَا سَيِّدِي مُطْمَئِنِّينَا اللّٰهُ اللّٰهُ
verses.tr:
ʿIbādu-r-Raḥmāni fī kulli zamān (2)
Lahumu-l-amān yā sayyidī muṭmaʾinnīnā
Yā sayyidī muṭmaʾinnīnā Allāhu Allāh
verses.en: The servants of the Most Merciful, in every age, have security — O my master, at peace, O my master, at peace.
